visual.name: plumePopulationPyramid
visual.description: Population pyramid and butterfly (tornado) chart with the Plume Studio look: ages in natural order, counts or shares, side totals, two measures face to face; premium: play axis that animates the pyramid year after year, computed age bands, surplus of one side, median and mean age lines, birth years, comparison outline (another year, another territory or a frame of the play axis), generation tracking, generation markers, demographic indicators, stacked sub-categories, projections and small multiples.
